parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-connection-count-records --db-cluster-id am-bp1jj9xqft1po0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
